narrative.headline: 2020 Hyundai Palisade: engine and windshield top the owner complaints
narrative.summary: Owners filed 506 complaints with NHTSA. The engine and the windshield/wiper area are nearly tied as the most reported, at 23% each, followed by the suspension (12%). No deaths are reported. The engine reports include 5 tied to a fire, the most of any area, so that area is worth a careful look.

issues.blurb: 60 reports (12%), with no crashes, fires, or injuries reported. Watch for vibration at highway speeds on a test drive.

issues.blurb: The fewest of the top five: 41 reports (8%), but tied to 4 injuries and 1 crash. Check that the electronics and driver-assist features work as expected.
